open-audio-fetch

A worldwide, community-maintained index of where free & legal audio lives — and a polite tool to fetch it.

15 sources (7 with a working adapter). Adapter: ✓ implemented · ⚑ experimental · ○ planned · ⓘ index. Redistribute: yes PD/CC0/CC-BY · conditional CC terms · personal-only · per-item. Every source offers audio free for personal use and permits fetching.

Machine-readable: catalog.json. Add a source via a small PR — see CONTRIBUTING.md.
